description: Workspace tools and GitHub sign-in for JBro Script Editor.
layoutEnabled: Use the JBro toolbar instead of the standard title bar tools. Menu bar and Activity Bar visibility are controlled separately.
showBuild: Show Build in the toolbar. Runs the workspace build task.
showRun: Show Run in the toolbar. Opens the task picker.
showDiagnostics: Show Errors / Logs in the toolbar. Opens Problems; Output and Terminal are available in the same bottom panel.
